svg.title: 31 · FDC / WH_Channel/Logic
svg.text: ADDED · CDL HMI observation: cmdWashHeat = Unload Not OK/manual wash request.
ADDED · A cancelled stamp before CDL timing started releases the selection without inventing a wash event.
ADDED · Prioritize the actual CDL start before any later decision or cycle event.
ADDED · Publish the explicit operator decision first when both observations await receipt; arrival times are advisory.
ADDED · Cycle Start from the selected press closes the undecided/accepted transfer in Ignition.
ADDED · Observe the accepted door-closed wash load before legacy copy/clear.
ADDED · Latch return location/time and reset its stopwatch at the actual return scan.
